source_table.notes:
Actual target attainment in individual septic rats
S08 | DOI 10.3390/antibiotics11111660 | Table 1
Neutropenic rats infected i.p. with 1 × 10^7 CFU; from 2 h after infection the four groups received the regimens in the header s.c. "for a period of 12 h"; controls got sterile saline. 60 rats, 5 groups of 12 (male/female 50/50). Mortality was then monitored for 7 days.
Text: values were "determined based on the measured meropenem concentrations and PK modeling", using 10 µL tail-vein whole blood at 0.083, 0.5, 1.5 h after the first dose and 0.167, 1, 2 h after the last dose. Those concentrations are in Supplementary Table S1 (not accessible). Table checked against the PDF.
